overview: Grav is a fast, flexible flat-file CMS with no database. This package runs the official Grav admin image.
description:
Grav is an open-source, modern flat-file CMS built on PHP. It stores content, configuration, and media as files instead of a database, which keeps the site portable and easy to back up and version.

Grav ships with a powerful Twig templating engine, Markdown-based content, and the Admin plugin for managing pages, themes, and plugins from the browser. This package deploys the LinuxServer.io Grav image with the Admin plugin included; the whole site, including user content and configuration, is persisted in a named volume mounted at /config.

Typical use cases include documentation sites, blogs, marketing sites, and small content-driven websites that want fast page loads and a simple, self-hosted setup without running a database.
